friendly_name: Corpus advisory suite budget you can defend
purpose_context: Issue #7206: the advisory Packs corpus suite runs at its 20-minute budget (measured p95 20.3 min, 102% of cap) and cancels on unrelated PRs. This mission records the measured cost breakdown, derives the cap with the repository's #5378 headroom formula, enforces it with a guard, and makes a budget expiry legible as INCOMPLETE (#4437) without touching selection semantics.
purpose_tldr: Derive the advisory corpus job's timeout from its measured worst case and make a budget expiry read as incomplete advisory, not a failed test.
